writeup: Woot has a genuine HP 26A black toner cartridge (model CF226A, UPC 889296154761) for $89.99. This is a single standard-yield cartridge rated for about 3,100 pages, and it fits LaserJet Pro M402 and M426 printers. Staples and Office Depot both list that same original HP CF226A cartridge in stock at $173.89, with Newegg, Provantage, and GM Supplies at $173.99, so this is 48 percent below the lowest of those prices and saves about $84. Quantity is capped, with at least three left and a limit of three per customer.
